uncertain_terms.note: Source typo for 'التصريح اليومى' (daily permit); rendered 'Daily permit'.

Source typo for 'تحت رئاستنا' (under our supervision); rendered by intent.
Source typo for 'يوم' (day); rendered by intent.
Rendered 'earths' / 'earthing connections' (Egyptian sector term for temporary earthing).
Worker's occupational safety and health category/class; rendered 'Occupational Safety and Health Category'.
WOF-003 has eight sections (preparation is Third, receipt Fourth) while WOF-002 has nine with a separate Third safety section; translated as numbered in the source.
Time field rendered 'hour minute', following the source field order (hour, then minute).
